name: uagents
description: Codex-led agy dispatch with native permissions, task tracking and artifact checks.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect agy readiness and track bounded agent tasks.
interface.longDescription: Development preview: dispatches agy tasks with native permissions, validates session identity and checks expected output files. No hard read-only or path isolation. Other adapters and MCP servers are not included.
interface.defaultPrompt: 通过 agy 委派一个有明确交付标准的小任务，跟进结果并检查产物。
